attested_fields.review_cycle: Annual scheduled review plus event-driven review on any material change to threats, technology, or regulatory obligations.
attested_fields.communication_method: Published in the policy portal; acknowledgement required from all staff at hire and at each annual revision via the attestation campaign.
attested_fields.exception_process: Time-bound exceptions requested in Concord, risk-assessed, and approved by the CISO with an expiry date and compensating controls.
